The '''Nahsu Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nahsu Minor]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Murachaun]] species.
